:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.8`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/useExpectToHaveBeenCalled`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has a [**safe**](/linter/#safe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`test`](/linter/domains#test)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`jest/prefer-to-have-been-called`](https://github.com/jest-community/eslint-plugin-jest/blob/main/docs/rules/prefer-to-have-been-called.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useExpectToHaveBeenCalled": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Enforce using `toHaveBeenCalled()` to check whether a mock function was called.

`toHaveBeenCalledTimes(0)` and `toBeCalledTimes(0)` check that a mock function was never
called by comparing its number of calls to zero. `not.toHaveBeenCalled()` states the same
check directly. When it fails, Jest and Vitest also list the calls that the function
received, which makes the failure easier to understand.

In the same way, `not.toHaveBeenCalledTimes(0)` checks that a mock function was called
at least once, which is what `toHaveBeenCalled()` does.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
expect(sendEmail).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(0);
```

### Valid

```js
expect(sendEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
expect(sendEmail).toHaveBeenCalled();
expect(sendEmail).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
expect(sendEmail).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(expectedCalls);
```
